# WS-SOAK RESULTS (generated by build-results.mjs; facts only; interpretation in REPORT.md)

All numbers come from `raw/` (artifacts of the CI jobs; results.json per job). FLAKE = pass/fail status of a test differing between complete jobs of the same backend. BIT-VARIANCE = value fingerprint differing while the test status is identical. Infra failure = job-level failure (apt/download/npm/runner/identity), counted separately.
